description: Retrieve one Where to use them catalog entry by its id, e.g. rider, studio, mcp. Read-only; returns the entry's name, price, notes, and links. Use when you know the exact entry id; use surface_search to find an id by keyword. An unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

id.description: Entry id within the Where to use them catalog, e.g. rider, studio, mcp. Get the id list from surface_search with an empty query; an unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

name: surface_get
